nvitk.io._common
================

.. py:module:: nvitk.io._common

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Shared I/O helpers: format aliases, axis reordering, NIfTI axis labels, orientation from affine.



Attributes
----------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.io._common._TYPE_ALIASES


Functions
---------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.io._common.normalize_type
   nvitk.io._common.reorder_axes
   nvitk.io._common._path_suffix
   nvitk.io._common.guess_read_type
   nvitk.io._common.guess_write_type

   nvitk.io._common.orientation_codes_from_affine


Module Contents
---------------

.. py:data:: _TYPE_ALIASES

.. py:function:: normalize_type(force_type: str | None) -> str | None

   Map *force_type* aliases (``nii``, ``dcm``, …) to canonical reader names, or None.


.. py:function:: reorder_axes(data: Any, axes_prev: str, axes_new: str) -> Any

   Permute *data* so axis labels match *axes_new* (same multiset of letters as *axes_prev*).

   :raises ValidationError: If lengths or letter sets differ from ``data.ndim``.


.. py:function:: _path_suffix(path: pathlib.Path) -> str

   File suffix for *path*, treating ``.nii.gz`` as a unit.


.. py:function:: guess_read_type(path: str | pathlib.Path, force_type: str | None = None) -> str

   Resolve which reader registry key to use (``nifti``, ``dicom``, …).

   If *force_type* is set, it wins after :func:`normalize_type`. Otherwise uses extension;
   directories default to ``dicom``.


.. py:function:: guess_write_type(path: str | pathlib.Path, force_type: str | None = None) -> str

   Like :func:`guess_read_type` but for output paths (writer registry keys).


.. py:function:: default_nifti_axes(ndim: int) -> str

   Default axis label string (``XY``, ``XYZ``, ``XYZT``, …) for *ndim*.


.. py:function:: orientation_codes_from_affine(affine: Any) -> str | None

   Return axis codes like ``"RAS"`` / ``"LPS"`` from a 4x4 voxel-to-world affine (nibabel).
